calculation_contract.formula: For identical useful work N and aligned total-energy window: E_on/E_off = (Pbar_on/Pbar_off)/(R_on/R_off), R=N/T.
calculation_contract.conditional_use_of_table10: Reported power values must first be established as comparable full-window means. The threshold is algebra, not a measured energy result.
calculation_contract.strict_advantage: R_on/R_off > Pbar_on/Pbar_off; equality means equal energy.
calculation_contract.fair_service: Same frame identities or agreed workload, precision/quality, complete pipeline and per-source service; aggregate rate cannot establish no starvation or deadline compliance.
not_done: No thermal threshold or physical simulation
